subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & Close cadence — NovaCare procurement constraints
messages:
From: Melanie Thompson <melanie@novacarehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Margaret Lee <margaret.lee@novacarelegal.com>, Procurement Portal <procurement@novacarehealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual action plan + procurement questionnaire (NovaCare)

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the demo last week — the eval team was impressed with the latency numbers and the dedupe examples. Procurement asked me to capture a target close window and to share our vendor intake questionnaire so legal/procurement can start their review in parallel.

Can you do the following by EOD Tuesday (2026-08-03)?
- Confirm who on Redwood will be the procurement point-of-contact for contract redlines.
- Provide a first-pass MAP (milestones + owners) that shows evaluation gating, security evidence, legal review, and signature target.
- Upload any corporate docs (SOC2, encryption whitepaper) to our portal (link below).

Attaching the vendor questionnaire — there are sections procurement will need filled out before routing to the budget owner. We have a strict DPA turnaround target of 3 business days from first redline received (vendor permitting).

Procurement portal: https://procure.novacarehealth.com/request/4521

Attachment: Novacare_Procurement_Q.pdf (60KB, pdf)

Appreciate quick alignment — Melanie

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-08-01T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + procurement questionnaire (NovaCare)

Thanks Melanie — looping in Kimberly (sales ops) and Karthik (legal ops) so we can run in parallel. I populated a draft MAP and attached it (MAP-draft-RK-v1.docx). High level plan below — please flag anything that doesn't match your internal steps.

PROPOSED MUTUAL ACTION PLAN (high level)
- Aug 3: Redwood to upload SOC2 + encryption brief to your portal; provide MAP draft and procurement POC. (Owner: Rachel)
- Aug 4–6: Security review (SSO + KMS questionnaire). If anything needs a live call, schedule the security deep-dive for Aug 6. (Owner: Redwood security)
- Aug 7: Legal sends initial MSA redline to NovaCare counsel (Owner: Redwood Legal - Karthik).
- Aug 10: NovaCare provides DPA redline back (target 3 business days).
- Aug 12: Order form and pricing sign-off; target DocuSign prepared. (Owner: Procurement)
- Aug 14: Target signature date (soft target — can be expedited with parallel redlines).

Notes / dependencies:
- If NovaCare requires Dedicated capacity SLA language, we will need scope and throughput targets by Aug 4 to size a brief addendum.
- Security evidence: SOC2 cert + KMS diagram + data residency statement. We will upload these to your portal today.

I'll upload the SOC2 and the short encryption brief to your portal now. Who should receive the Docusign orderform when it's ready (single recipient or procurement team distribution)?

Attachment: MAP-draft-RK-v1.docx (13KB, docx)

Thanks — Rachel

Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + procurement questionnaire (NovaCare)

Quick thoughts from ops/legal ops:
- Recommend adding an SSO smoke test milestone between security review and legal sign-off (we usually request IdP handshake + test user by day 2 of security).
- If NovaCare plans to require HSM-backed KMS for production keys, we should surface expected timeline (procurement lead may need to budget for infra).
- For the DPA: we can return a clean redline in 48 hours for standard terms; anything bespoke (audit frequency, subprocessor addenda) may extend the window.

I'll prepare a short checklist for the security call and share it after reviewing the portal upload.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
From: Melanie Thompson <melanie@novacarehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Margaret Lee <margaret.lee@novacarelegal.com>, Procurement Portal <procurement@novacarehealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + procurement questionnaire (NovaCare)

Thanks — that MAP looks reasonable. A couple of constraints from my side:
- Budget owner will only sign if DPA redlines are returned within 3 business days of receiving the vendor redline. If Redwood can start with a DPA redline on Aug 7, we need responses by Aug 10.
- Our legal counsel (cc'd) prefers to handle the MSA redlines directly; Margaret will send a short note outlining the non-negotiables (audit windows, data retention limits).
- Procurement prefers DocuSign distribution to procurement@novacarehealth.com and the assigned budget owner; please include procurement@novacarehealth.com as the recipient.

Link to the intake where you can upload artifacts: https://procure.novacarehealth.com/request/4521

We also logged a ticket with our cybersecurity team requesting a brief call for Aug 6 — target 30 minutes. I'll confirm the exact time after they triage.

Best,
Melanie
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Melanie Thompson <melanie@novacarehealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-08-05T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + procurement questionnaire (NovaCare)

Appreciate the constraints — confirmed below and listing next steps so we have a clean action board.

FINALIZED ACTIONS / OWNERS & TARGETS
1) Artifact upload (today, Aug 5): SOC2 report, encryption brief, KMS diagram uploaded to your portal. (Owner: Rachel)
2) Security smoke test (Aug 6): 30-minute call to validate SSO test user + prefix isolation. Kimberly will lead the checklist. (Owner: Kimberly)
3) MSA redline (Aug 7): Redwood legal (Karthik) will issue initial MSA redline.
4) DPA redline window (Aug 7–10): NovaCare to provide DPA comments within 3 business days of our redline.
5) Order form prep (Aug 9–11): Redwood to prepare DocuSign package and send to procurement@novacarehealth.com + budget owner.
6) Target signature (Aug 14): Soft target. If DPA is clean on Aug 10 we can accelerate to Aug 12.

A couple of clarifying asks: please confirm (a) the budget owner email for DocuSign distribution and (b) whether NovaCare requires an HSM addendum so we can size a Dedicated SLA if needed.

Attachment: redline-instructions.pdf (4KB, pdf)
DocuSign link (to be generated after orderform prep): https://www.docusign.com/link/NTX-4521-orderform

If that looks good I'll lock the MAP and schedule a 15-minute sync for Aug 6 (security) — proposed window 09:30–10:00 PT.

Thanks — Rachel
(End of thread)
